records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin fōrma 'shape, figure, image, outline, plan, mold, frame, case, etc., manner, sort, kind, etc.'

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin īnfōrmō 'to shape, form, train, instruct, educate', from in- 'into' + fōrma 'form, shape'

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from its Latin dēfōrmis, from dē- + fōrma

note: form / inform / deform 三条独立条目均给出 fōrma；deform 条目另注 fōrma 的进一步来源尚无定论（或与 μορφή 有关，Pre-Greek）。
